text:
Alex Chen: quick q — we're planning to add a `billing` block to /v1/usage responses to include cached tokens. Proposed fields:

```
"billing": {
  "prompt_tokens": 123,
  "completion_tokens": 45,
  "cached_prompt_tokens": 30,
  "cached_completion_tokens": 10,
  "chargeable_units": 128
}
```

Is that OK for accounting + backwards compat?

Jamie Ortiz: LGTM as a shape, but worried about semantics. Right now `prompt_tokens` is used in multiple places for both display and billing. We should avoid changing its meaning and accidentally double-counting cached tokens. :thinking_face:

Priya Singh: +1 to not repurpose `prompt_tokens`. Suggestion: keep existing keys exactly as-is and add explicit billing-only fields: `total_prompt_tokens` (raw), `cached_prompt_tokens`, and `chargeable_prompt_tokens`. That keeps the old contract stable.

Kevin M.: SDK concern: renaming or moving values is breaking. We should add an optional top-level `billing` object (nullable) and keep all legacy fields untouched for now. SDKs can read `billing.chargeable_units` if present, fallback to legacy math.

Alex Chen: good point. Plan update: add optional `billing` object, populate `chargeable_*` fields, do not remove/rename legacy fields. Gate via feature flag `billing_v2` for rollout.

Samantha L.: also recommend adding `tool_tokens` split for function/tool calls, e.g. `tool_prompt_tokens` and `tool_completion_tokens` under `billing` so downstream invoicing can separate third-party tools. Small example in docs would help customers reconcile.

billing-bot: Automated note: Reconciliation rule updated 2024-06-12 — when `billing.chargeable_units` is present use it as primary invoicing metric. If absent, fallback to legacy `prompt_tokens + completion_tokens` math.

Jamie Ortiz: one more edge — cached prefixes (KV cache) may be used by runtime but are not chargeable for some customers (internal policy). We need a clear boolean per-request like `billing.cached_prefix_included: false` or simply ensure `cached_*` fields are explicit and documented.

Priya Singh: agreed. I'll draft the spec:
- new optional `billing` object
- fields: `total_prompt_tokens`, `total_completion_tokens`, `cached_prompt_tokens`, `cached_completion_tokens`, `tool_prompt_tokens`, `tool_completion_tokens`, `chargeable_prompt_tokens`, `chargeable_completion_tokens`, `chargeable_units`
- deprecation policy: none for legacy fields for 6 months after rollout
- reconciliation note for accounting team

Kevin M.: I'll add SDK getters that prefer `billing.chargeable_*` and fallback to the legacy sums. I'll also add unit tests simulating cached vs non-cached responses.

Alex Chen: actionable list:
- Priya: PR with JSON schema + tests + reconciliation doc (due in 48h)
- Kevin: SDK changes + compat tests (due in 96h)
- Samantha: rollout plan + feature flag gating + example snippets (due in 72h)
- Jamie: quick review on accounting edge cases after PR (ASAP)

Samantha L.: will also add a canary note: only enable `billing_v2` for internal customers and first-party configs, then expand. I'll include an example invoice mapping.

Priya Singh: opening PR now with draft schema and a few example responses. ping me if you want a walkthrough.

Jamie Ortiz: thanks — sounds safe. :thumbsup:

Alex Chen: great work everyone. once PR merged I'll update docs + changelog and notify support/billing.

Kevin M.: quick FYI — I'll include a changelog entry in SDK and a test harness for the reconciliation script.

billing-bot: FYI: Reconciliation job queued for next run.

Alex Chen: ok wrapping up here. if anything changes, call it out in the PR comments. :rocket:
